content.about: Somalia sits on the Horn of Africa and has the longest coastline in mainland Africa. Most of its land is dry plains. Camel herding is a big part of life. Somali poetry has a strong oral tradition.

standout.text: Las Geel caves in the Somali region hold some of Africa's best-preserved ancient rock paintings.

didYouKnow: Somalia has one of the largest camel populations in the world.
Somalia is sometimes called a "nation of poets".
Its coastline is about 3,000 km long.
